report_types.label: Standard Report
report_types.description: General purpose report with flexible structure suitable for most use cases. Includes title, executive summary, main content, findings, recommendations and conclusion.

report_types.label: Technical Report
report_types.description: Detailed technical documentation with methodology, analysis, results and technical specifications. Ideal for engineering, development or scientific contexts.

report_types.label: Business Report
report_types.description: Executive-focused report with business context, strategic implications, ROI analysis and implementation plans. Perfect for stakeholders and decision makers.

report_types.label: Executive Summary
report_types.description: Concise high-level overview (2-3 paragraphs) highlighting key topics, findings and insights. Quick summary for busy executives.
